input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only limitation-of-liability provision; it mutually excludes special, indirect and consequential damages and mutually carves breaches of Section 13 (IP indemnity, p0090) and Section 14 (Confidentiality, p0095) out of the limitation, but it contains no aggregate monetary cap at all, so each party's direct-damages exposure (including ours) is unlimited. That fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap based on 12 months' fees. We therefore add a single mutual cap sentence inside Section 15 at the fallback level (fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim) with gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap; the existing final sentence of Section 15 keeps the indemnity and confidentiality obligations uncapped, so no further carve-outs are needed. We have not pursued the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor or the additional preferred carve-outs.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-months'-fees aggregate liability cap in Section 15, with gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but sets no monetary cap, so our direct-damages exposure is unlimited; we add a mutual cap at the fallback position of 12 months' fees. Gross negligence and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap, and the existing carve-out for breaches of Sections 13 and 14 keeps the indemnity and confidentiality obligations uncapped.

ops.text: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, and this cap shall not apply to a party's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
